messages:
april_sales: Quick intake  client: MeridianPay. They asked if we can onboard `silverback-13b-open` v3.1 and pin it to eu-central and ap-south. Requirement: 4-bit quant + model residency for payroll PII. Are we blocked on license or infra? :thinking_face:
noah_product: Thanks April. Short clarifiers: 1) steady qps / burst? 2) target tail percentile (p95/p99)? 3) Dedicated required or is hosted geo-pin ok?
april_sales: Expected steady 12 qps, spikes to 60 qps. p95 <= 260ms. They prefer hosted with geo-only routing but may pay for Dedicated if needed. Also want strict version pin v3.1 (no auto-updates).
sophia_mlops: Silverback-13b has community weights; I don't see prebuilt 4-bit artifacts in our registry. We'll need to run quant pipeline and regression tests. If kernels are fine, quant + validation ~2-4 infra days. Need model tarball + license to confirm export control.
tony_infra: For EU + AP-South pinning: we need regional replication of artifacts, KMS per region, and routing rules. For 12qps steady and p95 260ms, estimate 2x A100-80 nodes per region with prefix KV cache enabled to hit SLOs. If bursts hit 60qps, autoscale/burst policy must be configured.
jen_legal: Please attach model license. If it is permissive (Apache/MIT) fine. If customer requests we produce quant artifacts on their data, we need IP clause in MSA. Also check export control for ap-south replication.
intake_bot: Intake created: RED-INTAKE-5528. Please attach: model tarball, license, sample prompts, billing contact, and MSA draft link.
noah_product: Proposed acceptance criteria before moving to backlog: - artifact + license uploaded and cleared by Legal - staging perf: p95 <= 260ms at 12 qps with their prompt set - quantized 4-bit artifact validated (no major regression on our eval set) - region replication + KMS keys provisioned for eu & ap-south - version pin config (v3.1) applied and tested - billing & MSA signed
april_sales: MeridianPay is okay with the acceptance criteria and can provide prompt set after MSA. They asked for a pilot in ap-south within 5 weeks.
sophia_mlops: I'll start a quant smoke once we have weights. If kernel tweaks required, call out +3 dev days. Will post results to RED-INTAKE-5528 by EOD Thursday.
tony_infra: I'll draft regional replication checklist and estimate infra hours in the intake ticket. Also will validate capacity math for burst handling.
jen_legal: I'll review license and MSA annex once attached; will flag any export or IP issues.
noah_product: OK I'll take product ownership for the rollout and move this into the backlog under "customer-onboards/eu-ap-south-pinning". Can we assign an infra owner and ML owner in the intake ticket before sprint planning?
april_sales: Assign infra -> @tony_infra, ml -> @sophia_mlops. Customer requests weekly updates.
noah_product: Got it. I'll update RED-INTAKE-5528 and set priority to P2 (customer pilot timeline requested).
